title: Successor frame initialization
statement: For natural numbers $F'$ and $n$, initializing $F'+1$ frames is the concatenation of initializing the first $F'$ frames with the two instructions that compute the address using $c_{\mathrm{ADDR}}$ and $c_{\mathrm{NFP}}$ and the pool cell at index $2F'$, then store either $c_T(F')$ when $F'<n$ or $c_{\mathrm{ZERO}}$ otherwise.
